newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican ex-bank official extradited from Spain.
newsitem.headline: Mexican ex-bank official extradited from Spain.

text.p: Ricardo Armoas Arroyo, the former legal director of Mexico's Banca Union who is accused of making $20 million in fraudulent loans, arrived in Mexico on Thursday after being extradited from Spain, a news report said.
The Televisa network reported in its nightly broadcast that Armas Arroyo was being held in Mexico City's Eastern Jail.
Spain granted the extradition of Armas Arroyo on April 17, Televisa said.
The Mexican Attorney General's Office accuses Armas Arroyo of making $20 million in fraudulent loans that led to the bankruptcy of Banca Union.
After fleeing Mexico, Armas Arroyo was arrested in Madrid on September 9, 1995.
